column1: # Third-party parts of MacSW.app. scripts/third_party_notices.py turns this table into
# Contents/Resources/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt at package time and stops the build when a part
# of the bundle is not listed here, or a listed path is missing.
#   component  version  licence  paths  source  texts  note
# paths: comma-separated globs relative to Contents/. A row whose globs all start with "?"
#   is optional (left out when nothing matches, e.g. SWCLI).
# texts: comma-separated licence texts, each printed once at the end of the file:
#   text:<file>    resources/licenses/third-party/<file> (copied from the project's release)
#   wine:<file>    a file of the pinned Wine source archive (wine-<version>/<file>)
#   bundle:<file>  a file already in the bundle, relative to Contents/
#   repo:<file>    a file of this source tree
# ${NAME} is replaced with a build value (config/versions.env, scripts/lib/config.sh).

column7: A modified version of MacSW, not an official MacSW release. The MacSW launcher, the SOLIDWORKS.app launcher and the SpatialIOP MSI edit helper (native/msi_spatialiop.c, built with MinGW-w64).

The runtime is the Gcenx macOS Wine build ${WINE_RUNTIME_URL} (SHA-256 ${WINE_RUNTIME_SHA256}). MacSW replaces some of its modules with modules built from the Wine source above and patches ${PATCHES}. Wine contains code from other projects (libpng, zlib, libxml2, libxslt, LibJPEG, LibTIFF, Little CMS, FluidSynth, mpg123, vkd3d, ICU, OpenLDAP, musl, LLVM and more); their notices are in Wine's NOTICES.md below.
